title: IGS - Innovative Global Solutions
blurb: President of a 30+ member engineering enterprise, after leading the incubator team's embedded systems and PCB design to a 1st Place Innovation Award.
body:
A major commitment of mine at Michigan Technological University is the Enterprise program, a cross-disciplinary student engineering program. I joined Innovative Global Solutions (IGS), where I began by helping develop a low-cost, low-power infant incubator solution for use in the developing world.

On the incubator project I worked extensively with the controls subteam, developing embedded C++ code on an Arduino microcontroller, signal processing for heartbeat detection, and circuit board design for a full PCB, while also supporting an atomization humidifier device and the incubator's heating components across teams. I later became Project Lead for the incubator team, managing tracking and deadlines across subsystems, and in my first semester leading the team, helped drive it to receive the 1st Place Innovation Award at the Spring 2025 Design Expo.

Since January 2026 I've served as President of IGS, transitioning from managing a single subteam to leading the entire 30+ member enterprise across all of its client projects. In this role I oversee day-to-day operations, coordinate project needs and resource allocation between teams and project leads, manage budget and stakeholder relationships, and continue to mentor younger members as the enterprise takes on new challenges and expands its impact.
